summary: Iteration 6 — Full backend + frontend testing of (a) Google Auth endpoint /api/auth/google/session, (b) CSV exports fix, (c) Navbar overflow fix at 1440px. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth_and_exports.py — 11/11 passed (Google auth 401/422 handling, admin JWT login + /me, 4 CSV exports return 200 with correct text/csv content-type, Content-Disposition filenames, and expected header columns). Also re-ran test_notifications_exports.py — previously xfailed CSV exports (delivery-requests/riders/merchants) are now XPASSED, confirming the explicit-headers + extrasaction='ignore' fix works. Frontend: Login page renders 'Continuer avec Google' button with multi-color Google icon SVG (PASS). Admin login (admin@plb.bj / plb2024) successfully redirects to /admin (PASS). HOWEVER, navbar overflow at 1440px is NOT FIXED — 'Demander une livraison' CTA still extends to ctaRight=1496 while viewport is 1440 (56px clipped). The xl:flex change makes the desktop nav appear at >=1280px, but at 1440 there isn't enough room for logo + 7 nav links + bell + admin dropdown + CTA.

ui_bugs.issue: Navbar still overflows at 1440px viewport — 'Demander une livraison' CTA clipped by ~56px (ctaRight=1496 vs viewport=1440). Changing lg→xl moved the breakpoint to 1280 but the content is still too wide for 1440. Measured: nav has 7 links (Accueil, Comment ça marche, Services & Tarifs, FAQ, À propos, Contact, Partenaire dropdown) + notification bell + Administrateur dropdown + CTA — all visible at 1440 but CTA is clipped on the right edge. Recommend: hide CTA below 2xl (1536px), OR shorten links (e.g. 'Tarifs' instead of 'Services & Tarifs', 'À propos' merged into Partenaire dropdown), OR reduce gap-2/gap-1 spacing, OR show CTA as icon-only button below 2xl.

action_items: HIGH (carried over, NOT fixed by xl breakpoint): Navbar overflow at 1440px — 'Demander une livraison' CTA clipped. xl breakpoint (1280) is too low for this many nav items. Move CTA visibility to 2xl (1536) OR consolidate links OR reduce spacing in /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx line 90.
critical_code_review_comments: Google Auth endpoint (server.py L500-591) is clean: uses httpx async client, 10s timeout, properly rejects 401 from Emergent Auth, validates email field presence, creates new users as 'merchant' role by default with auth_provider='google'+picture URL stored — good defaults. One nit: GoogleSessionRequest.session_id has no min_length validator, so empty string passes Pydantic and only fails at Emergent Auth call (still returns 401 cleanly, but adding constr(min_length=1) would be cleaner).

CSV exports (server.py L1755-1860) — all 4 export endpoints now use the explicit headers + extrasaction='ignore' pattern consistently. This is the right fix and matches the working /api/admin/export/finances pattern. Confirmed: delivery-requests, riders, merchants, feedback all return 200 with correct CSV body parseable by csv.reader.
AuthCallback flow not directly testable without real Emergent Auth session, but redirect URL construction in LoginPage.jsx L57 uses window.location.origin (dynamic, correct) — not hardcoded.

Navbar.jsx desktop section at L72/L90 uses 'hidden xl:flex' — correct intent but xl=1280 leaves too little room for the full nav at 1440. The previous iteration_5 report flagged the same overflow; the chosen fix (lg→xl) is insufficient. Either use 2xl OR redesign the nav.
Login page (LoginPage.jsx L271-287) Google button correctly uses 'Continuer avec Google' label, has data-testid='google-login-btn', shows custom multicolor Google SVG icon, has loading state.

rca of the issue: Navbar overflow RCA — Reproduction: page.set_viewport_size(1440, 900) → goto / → measure 'Demander une livraison' anchor — ctaRight=1496, navRight=934 (nav element is parent that doesn't expand), overflowing=true. Root cause: Navbar.jsx L90 'hidden xl:flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0' shows the full action group (NotificationBell + Administrateur DropdownMenu + Demander CTA) at >=1280px, but together with the 7 nav links at L72 (also xl:flex with gap-1) and the GoLiv logo, total content width at default text sizes is ~1496px. The header container is max-w-7xl (=1280px) with px-4 (=32px each side), so usable width is 1216px at 1280 viewport but at 1440 the container caps at 1280+padding=1344px effective — still <1496. Fix options: (a) change L90 'hidden xl:flex' → 'hidden 2xl:flex' so CTA only appears at >=1536, (b) remove max-w-7xl on the header and use full viewport width, (c) trim nav link labels.
